title: PR8255 Staging Recovery Phase B file-handle hardening

phases.objective: Harden Phase B approval-token single issuance and restart-safe reads across Windows and POSIX without authorizing deployment, provider, database, grant, migration, or Production mutation.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Resolve and issue the server-owned Phase B approval token from the durable filesystem authority.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: One approval produces at most one durable token record, restart reads remain fail-closed, exact recovery bindings remain intact, and Production mutation remains unauthorized.
steps: Create the issuance claim with exclusive file creation and keep the pinned file handle through finalization.
Durably sync the claim using the repository recovery filesystem durability primitive and finalize the issued record through the same descriptor.
On Windows, reopen existing state only through lstat, open, fstat identity verification; on POSIX retain no-follow semantics.
Run the focused Phase B, authority-binding, certification-protocol, and platform-convergence regressions.
assertions: The existing single-issuance and binding semantics remain unchanged.
Partial writes and corrupt token state fail closed.
Windows path replacement or non-file state is rejected before token reuse.
POSIX claim creation follows the repository directory-sync durability contract.
Both staging and production impact are explicitly reviewed, live staging certification remains required, and production_mutation_allowed is false.
No deployment, provider, database, grant, migration, credential payload, or Production mutation is performed by this repository change.
